How it works · Architecture

One service, one index, a choice of models

Browser
SvelteKit page, served by the same service. No install.
FastAPI service · Python
Search
Hybrid search, rerank, verified answers first
Answer
Prompt with five passages, model fallback, streaming
Ledger
Every question, model call and rating (SQLite)
makes feedback measurable
Index
Qdrant, embedded. Every passage, each with a meaning vector and a keyword vector.
bge-small embeddingsMiniLM rerankerONNX, on CPU
Models
The first that answers writes the answer.
Hosted model AHosted model BLocal model · our hardwareSearch only
Ingestion
File-share copy · team notes · reference catalogues → read, OCR, clean, guard, split, embed → index. Offline, incremental.
How it works · Ingestion

Every file is read, cleaned and checked first

Collect
File-share copy, team notes, reference catalogues
Read
PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint; scans by OCR
Clean
Contents pages, embedded blobs, repeated headers out
Guard
Credentials removed, or the file held back
Split
By headings, about 1,800 characters each
Embed
Meaning: 384 numbers. Words: a keyword vector.
Index
Only changed files are read again
OCRscanned manuals made readable
Heldfiles with credentials held back, never indexed
TablesWord and Excel tables kept as rows, not flattened away

these five go to the model
1
Wide netBoth searches merged into 45 candidates. Near the top of either, a passage rises (rank fusion).
2
Careful readerA small model reads the question with each candidate and scores how well it answers (a cross-encoder).
3
House rules
  • Only the simulator the question names
  • That machine's own inventory first
  • Passages verified by hand on top

How it works · Data

Documents stay in the building. Only a question and five passages may leave.

Stays in the building
DocumentsA copy; the originals are never touched.
Index and searchEmbeddings and reranking run on our CPUs.
LedgerQuestions, ratings, which model was called.
CredentialsRemoved before indexing, or the file held back.
Local modelOn our hardware, when nothing may leave.
Two audiencesEvery file tagged internal or operator-visible, ready for sign-in.
question +
5 passages
Hosted model The hosted model receives the question and the five passages it answers from. Nothing else. Choose the local model to send nothing.

How we built it · Feedback

A thumbs-down becomes a fix

A rating with a note is the most valuable thing in the system.

Every reported question is replayed against each new build. Its status is measured, never ticked by hand, and shown to everyone in the app.

Aska real question
Ratethumbs and a note
Ledgerkept with the answer
Replayagainst the new build
Fix and testthe cause, not the answer
Guarda golden question
Every buildreplays every report
